{{Quote|Master Sinube, you're right. I've found the intruder and she has my lightsaber. She's a Terrelian Jango Jumper, and hard to keep up with.|Ahsoka Tano to Tera Sinube|audio=TerellianJangoJumper1-LL.flac|<ref name="Lightsaber Lost" />}}
'''Cassie Cryar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Terrelian Jango Jumper/Legends|Terrelian Jango Jumper]] who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. As a Terrelian Jango Jumper, Cryar possessed advanced skills in acrobatics and agility. Using these natural gifts, Cryar made a living as a thief in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]] with her accomplice, [[Ione Marcy/Legends|Ione Marcy]]. During one of her operations, Cryar assisted Marcy in the murder of her boyfriend, a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] by the name of [[Nack Movers/Legends|Nack Movers]]. The two then ransacked [[Nack Movers's residence/Legends|Movers' apartment]], looting a [[Ahsoka Tano's lightsabers/Legends|lightsaber]] which Movers had recently purchased from a [[Bannamu/Legends|petty pickpocket]] while planning to leave Coruscant and start a life together

When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], the original owner of the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]] arrived at the condo of Mover's girlfriend to retrieve the stolen Jedi weapon, Cryar fled the scene, prompting Tano to pursue. Cryar eluded Tano with her natural gifts of agility and speed long enough to escape the Padawan with the assistance of Marcy, fleeing to a [[Train station/Legends|train station]] in Marcy's [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] in an attempt to lose the Jedi. However, using a [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking beacon]], Sinube tracked the two thieves to the station and attempted to apprehend the pair. Cryar fled onto one of the departing [[Hovertrain/Legends|hovertrains]] with Tano still in pursuit, leading to a short stand-off when the desperate Terrelian took hostages in order to keep Tano at bay. However, when the train came to a halt, Sinube was already waiting; the elderly Jedi Master [[Sun djem/Legends|disarmed]] Cryar, and she was taken into custody, the stolen lightsaber having been retrieved by Tano.

==Biography==
[[File:Terellian_jango_jumper.jpg|thumb|left|175px|Cassie Cryar was a very agile Coruscant thief]]
Cassie Cryar was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Terrelian Jango Jumper/Legends|Terrelian Jango Jumper]] who [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Terrelia/Legends|Terrelia]].<ref name="TCWCE" /> At some point prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Cryar came to live on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], taking up residence in the planet's [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underworld]], where, over [[Time/Legends|time]], she made a comfortable living for herself as a criminal.

Her inherent speed and agility that came with being a member of the Terrelian race allowed her to avoid [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]]. During her life of crime on Coruscant, Cryar met the young [[Ione Marcy/Legends|Ione Marcy]],<ref name="NewBattlefronts">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> and the two became close to each other.<ref name="Lightsaber Lost" />

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Star Wars Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> Marcy's boyfriend, a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] by the name of [[Nack Movers/Legends|Nack Movers]], obtained a stolen [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] from a [[Bannamu/Legends|pickpocket]] that had previously belonged to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. Tano, with the help of the elder [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]], tracked [[Ahsoka Tano's lightsabers/Legends|her lightsaber]] to [[Nack Movers's residence/Legends|Movers' apartment]]. Cryar and Marcy had already [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Trandoshan criminal, however, and when Tano searched the apartment, discovered Cryar hiding in another room with the stolen saber. Cryar punched her to the ground before attempting to attack the Jedi Padawan with her own lightsaber, but was unfamiliar with the weapon and unable to activate it; when Ahsoka exclaimed in shock at the lightsaber being hers, Cryar realized she was a Jedi and panicked. Kicking out a [[Window/Legends|window]], Cryar led Tano on a harrowing chase over the Coruscant rooftops. Sinube remained at the apartment with Marcy, who doubted the girl's claimed innocence in Movers' murder.<ref name="Lightsaber Lost" />

[[File:CryarMarcyEscape-LL.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Cryar and Marcy escape with the pilfered lightsaber]]
Discovering how to operate the Jedi's weapon amid her escape effort, Cryar used the [[Color/Legends|green]]-bladed lightsaber to cut down exterior fixtures in an attempt to block Tano's path and halt her pursuit. However, to Cryar's surprise and frustration, the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] Padawan proved unshakable, following Cryar as she leaped onto a floating billboard and continued onto a second in a series of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]]-equipped advertisements that stretched across the wide gap between [[Skyscraper/Legends|skyscrapers]]; Cryar used the stolen lightsaber to damage the billboards' [[Repulsorlift generator/Legends|repulsorlift generator]], temporarily stranding the Padawan before she leaped onto a passing [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] and continued the chase. Tano nearly sent Cryar falling to her doom when she [[Telekinesis/Legends|ripped]] a pipe Cryar had been climbing down using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], leaving her dangling over a busy Coruscant [[Skylane/Legends|skylane]]. Cryar, though, simply climbed on top of the long segment of pipe, and jumped from it into a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] driven by Ione Marcy, who had fled when a unit of [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|CSF]] [[Police droid/Legends|police droids]] arrived at the apartment. Together, the pair escaped the Padawan's pursuit and traveled to one of Coruscant's many [[Hovertrain/Legends|hovertrain]] [[Train station/Legends|stations]],<ref name="Lightsaber Lost" /> intending to reach the station before the Jedi or the police, blend in among the large crowds of beings, and escape on a [[6-B hover train|train]] and later get a ship off world.<ref name="NewBattlefronts" />

[[File:SinubeVsMarcy.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Cryar unsuccessfully attempts to fight off Tera Sinube with her stolen lightsaber]]
Unfortunately for Cryar and her accomplice, Master Sinube had planted a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] on Marcy while still at the apartment, and together he and Tano followed the duo to the station. Cryar discovered the device and subsequently destroyed it before spotting Tano in the crowd. She [[Sai tok/Legends|destroyed]] a pair of police droids who attempted to arrest her at the Jedi's order, and leaped onto the train as it departed the station, abandoning Marcy in the process. Tano again followed, and Cryar broke into the train's interior through a side window, taking a female [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] and her child hostage with the lightsaber as the Padawan closed in on her. Tano requested a trade, wherein the hostages would be released for her, but knowing the Jedi's ability to [[Force power/Legends|use the Force]], Cryar refused. When the train stopped at the next station along its route, however, Sinube was waiting and [[Sun djem/Legends|disarmed]] the untrained Terrelian with [[Tera Sinube's sabercane|his own lightsaber]] as the hostages ran before knocking Cryar unconscious with [[Sabercane/Legends|his cane]]. Cryar was then taken into custody by a group of CSF police droids, and the lightsaber she had stolen was recovered by Tano.<ref name="Lightsaber Lost" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Cassie_Cryar_Art_of_SWTCW.jpg|thumb|right|120px|Cassie Cryar]]
{{Quote|I've got a lightsaber, and I'm as powerful as a Jedi!|Cassie Cryar's belief that a Jedi's strength came from wielding a lightsaber|<ref name="Lightsaber Lost" />}}
Cassie Cryar's heritage as a Terrelian Jango Jumper afforded her impressive physical abilities that made her a tireless sprinter and exceptionally agile.<ref name="NewBattlefronts" /> She could leap vast distances comparable to a Jedi's [[Force jump/Legends|Force-amplified jumps]], despite not being [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]. In fact, Cryar believed (somewhat arrogantly) that with her racial abilities, coupled with her use of Ahsoka Tano's stolen lightsaber, she was just as strong as any Jedi.<ref name="Lightsaber Lost" /> As a Terrelian, Cryar was blue-skinned and long-[[Limb/Legends|limbed]], and her hands had a strong grip. She chose to hide her face behind a mask of white [[Bone/Legends|bone]], segmented at the mouth, and tied her red hair atop her head in a topknot. Cryar was bold, unafraid of falling from the great heights of Coruscant's rooftops that others would consider dizzying,<ref name="NewBattlefronts" /> but was also prone to acting without thinking, evident when she threatened Ahsoka Tano with the Padawan's lightsaber without any training in how to operate it, or even the knowledge of how to turn the weapon on; she also had a tendency to swing the stolen lightsaber carelessly at surrounding objects and people, apparently without realizing the damage she could do to herself and others. Cryar also took a pair of hostages aboard a moving hover train when confronted by Tano, desperate and with nowhere else to run. She maintained a friendship with a fellow female resident of Coruscant's underworld named Ione Marcy but abandoned her when faced with the threat of arrest.<ref name="Lightsaber Lost" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Cassie is very mischievous and strong, but I also like that she's not sure what she's doing once she gets the lightsaber. She's not necessarily all bad; she's doing what she has to do in order to survive. She's also quite charming in a way. She has this acrobatic, beautiful way of moving as well, especially during the chase scenes with Ahsoka.|[[Jaime King]]|<ref name="Thick as Thieves">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20100122.html|text=Jaime King and Meredith Salenger: Thick as Thieves}}</ref>}}
[[File:CassieCryarconcept.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Concept art of Cassie Cryar]]
Cassie Cryar appeared in the eleventh episode of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]]' [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]], entitled "[[Lightsaber Lost]]." Voiced by actress [[Jaime King]], Cryar was a featured [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] in the season's ''Rise of the Bounty Hunters'' storyline. King, who had previously voiced bounty hunter [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] for the show, was drawn to the role for the character's strength. King does not consider Cryar to be a bad person, believing that she is only doing what she needs to do to survive.<ref name="Thick as Thieves" /> Despite being referred to as a bounty hunter once by Tera Sinube, Cryar's actions during the episode itself are only those of a thief, and she does not engage in any bounty hunting during the course of the plot.

The design of Cassie Cryar was based on one of [[Iain McCaig]]'s early [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] concepts for the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], the first installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]].<ref name="Sith Inspiration">{{SW|url=news/back-from-the-drawing-board-recycled-star-wars-aliens|text=Back from the Drawing Board: Recycled ''Star Wars'' Aliens|int=Back from the Drawing Board|nolive=1}}</ref>

Though not a unanimous opinion, some viewers of "Lightsaber Lost," including several on a [[Jedi Council Forums]] thread, noted subtext that suggested Cassie Cryar and Ione Marcy were in a romantic relationship.<ref name="JCFCite">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31842778|board=Star Wars TV- Completed Shows|thread=Grade the Episode: 211: Lightsaber Lost|quote=Kudos to the TCW team for at least implying a lesbian relationship (it's a little unclear), we definitely haven't seen that before, and I'm glad they don't beat us over the head with how "thoughtful" they are to do so; you would think in 2011 it wouldn't be an issue at all to have a lesbian couple in Star Wars.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170803190829/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/grade-the-episode-211-lightsaber-lost.31841297}}</ref> In [[2016]], [[Pablo Hidalgo]] stated on his [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] account that they were written to be a couple.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/703684857121996800|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2016-02-27|quote=For those talking about the subject, note that Cassie Cryar and Ione Marcy were written as a couple in a relationship.|archivefile=File:CassieCryar_IoneMarcy_PabloHidalgo_tweet.png|nolive=1}}</ref>
